plan_scope: S1-015 group quantification tables and S1-009 effective-n/CV traceability. Descriptive tables only: no plots/PCA/DE/batch correction/outlier exclusion/new preprocessing or normalization.

inputs.parent: Full trusted saved positive-log2/None/no-imputation version metadata. Existing project/raw dataset/file/source SHA/config/report/flags/family/version/manifest and all11 original artifact pins are retained in provenance. Caller must validate saved metadata/schema and Owner before any future integration; this numeric function does not confer authority.
inputs.artifacts: Complete original11 saved bytes. digest SHA256/length checked before/after. Exact original fixed manifest order, not locale sort. Full raw-retained and working-matrix prefixes, rows, samples and four masks must match. Original raw/working/masks/files are read only.
inputs.raw_observed: Original raw token must be blank or finite nonnegative numeric; overflow/underflow/malformed tokens refuse. Original zero (including +0.0e0) and blank exactly match their source masks and working_NA union. Only remaining finite positive original intensity values enter raw statistics.
inputs.log2: Existing saved finite log2 values remain separate. Raw/log2 identity is cross-checked with base log2 at1e-12 relative tolerance solely for integrity, without regenerating any working matrix or preprocessing artifact.
inputs.imputation: Only original None/no-imputation parent is supported. TRUE imputed masks refuse rather than silently count generated values as observations.
inputs.design: Exact saved design for same project/original dataset/family; complete selected column order/names, confirmed nonblank group and original replicate_type/control/condition/replicate metadata. No WT/100/sample-name inference. Full original saved record retained.
inputs.unsupported: Missing/unconfirmed/mismatching design, Median or other normalized parent, imputed data, malformed/nonfinite/underflow raw tokens, changed byte pins or mask/scale mismatch refuse the whole operation.

rows_and_identity.coverage: Every original retained protein-group record x every saved group, even n_valid0. Original increasing record_number and exact protein_ids_raw retained, including duplicates and multi-member strings; no primary ID selection, member splitting, dedup or missing-driven row removal.
rows_and_identity.order: Original row order, then group first-appearance order from saved design.
rows_and_identity.sample_metadata: sample-design.tsv retains every original design row/column and replicate_type; groups.tsv records group size and ordered declared types. No technical/unknown type is promoted to biological.

statistics.counts: n_total original group columns; n_valid finite positive observed raw cells; n_missing original zero+blank missing cells; original_zero_n/original_blank_n/imputed_n explicit; effective_n=n_valid. n_total=n_valid+n_missing.
statistics.raw_mean_median_SD: base::mean, stats::median, stats::sd on observed raw positive intensities. SD uses n_valid-1 sample denominator.
statistics.CV: cv_raw=raw_sample_SD/raw_mean; unitless original positive-intensity scale only.
statistics.log2_summary: Independent saved-log2 mean/median/sample-SD columns explicitly labeled saved_log2. Never calculate or label SD(log2)/mean(log2) as CV.
statistics.n_zero: All mean/median/SD/CV/RSD fields NA, status all_missing; never fill0.
statistics.equal_observations: n>=2 equal finite positive values legitimately give SD0/CV0; distinct from all-missing.
statistics.numerical_failure: Nonfinite mean/median/SD becomes NA with nonfinite_mean/nonfinite_median/nonfinite_sd. Nonpositive mean, nonfinite CV or RSD yields explicit nonpositive_mean/nonfinite_cv/nonfinite_rsd status; no dropped row or artificial finite substitute.
statistics.biological_consistency: replicate_types retained per group and full sample design. Non-biological/unknown, insufficient group n and insufficient observed n are explicitly distinguished. Even all-declared-biological/n>=2 is descriptive_only_consistency_not_assessed; biological_consistency_passed FALSE means no success asserted, not evidence of failed biological consistency. No independence, threshold, significance or biological consistency test is performed.

serialization: Full UTF8 LF quoted TSV, numeric %.17g and NA tokens. Parameters state both scales/formulas/n policies. Full parent/design/source/parameters and actual R/session versions retained. Output byte pins supplied by finite operator coordinator, no controlled publication claim.
resources: 1..10000 source rows, <=512 selected samples and2M selected cells; <=100000 row-group outputs, conservative estimated table bytes<=64MiB. Each output<=32MiB and total<=128MiB. Overflow rejects, no truncation. Process/wall/memory admission belongs to a future reviewed runner; this function is inert on source and not a process sandbox.
